description: Manufacturing press P-001 reports abnormal vibration. Sensor event is ingested, scored by Astraea, and routed to mechanical team.

expected_decision.root_cause_hypothesis: Bearing degradation causing vibration cascade. Similar to INC-2023-089.
expected_decision.recommendation: Route to mechanical team immediately. Schedule bearing replacement within 2 hours.

expected_feedback.note: Correct priority. Bearing was indeed degraded.

resolution.summary: Bearing replaced. Vibration returned to normal (RMS 4.2).
